name: swell
description: A Gecko-based browser application with per-space profile isolation. Logins, autofill, form history and places history are kept per container, behind prefs that default to Firefox's behaviour. Maintained as a patch queue on top of Firefox ESR, with the upstreamable changes kept small.
readme_summary: Swell is a minimal, open-source browser built on the Gecko engine, offering per-space profile isolation. It allows users to maintain separate identities, cookies, history, and extensions for different contexts within a single browser window, enhancing privacy and organization.
key_features: Per-space identity isolation (cookies, storage, history, passwords, extensions, permissions, downloads)
Sidebar tree (favorites, pinned tabs, folders)
Command bar
Tab restore and Cmd+Z for deleted rows
Encrypted passwords and form data per space
WebExtensions per space
Per-space camera, microphone, and screen sharing permissions
No telemetry or automatic updates
primary_use_case: To provide users with a highly organized and private browsing experience by isolating different online activities into distinct 'spaces' within a single browser window.
cover_image_prompt: A vibrant, stylized illustration of a librarian meticulously organizing a vast library. Each book on the shelves represents a different 'space' or profile. The librarian is placing a new book onto a shelf, and as they do, a small, glowing digital aura surrounds it, signifying its unique identity and isolated data. In the background, subtle UI elements resembling browser tabs and a sidebar are visible, integrated into the library's architecture. The overall mood is one of order, control, and digital privacy. The style is a clean, modern 3D isometric illustration with a bright, inviting color palette, emphasizing the concept of 'spaces' within a unified structure. The repository name 'Swell' is subtly etched onto a library signpost.

name: cleanyourtv
description: Debloat any Android or Google TV over Wi-Fi and get an Apple TV-style home.
readme_summary: CleanYourTV is a Python-based tool that allows users to debloat their Android TV or Google TV devices over Wi-Fi. It replaces the default, ad-filled home screen with a clean, Apple TV-style launcher without requiring root access or uninstalling any applications, and provides a simple restore option.
key_features: Debloat Android TV/Google TV over Wi-Fi
Replace stock launcher with Apple TV-style launcher
No root required
No applications uninstalled
One-line restore option
Supports various TV brands (Sony Bravia, TCL, Xiaomi, etc.)
Community-built app for Android phones
primary_use_case: To remove bloatware and ads from Android TV/Google TV home screens, replacing them with a cleaner, more user-friendly interface similar to Apple TV, all managed wirelessly.
cover_image_prompt: A magical wand, subtly branded with 'CleanYourTV', is transforming a cluttered, ad-filled television screen into a sleek, minimalist interface resembling an Apple TV home screen. The cluttered screen is depicted as a chaotic mess of pop-up ads and icons, while the transformed screen shows a clean grid of apps. Digital particles flow from the wand, cleansing the screen. In the background, a Wi-Fi symbol connects the wand to the TV. The overall mood is one of transformation and simplification, rendered in a clean, 3D isometric illustration style with a bright, modern color palette.

name: screenplink
description: A laser dry-fire shooting game: your matte monitor is the target, an ordinary webcam watches it from the side, and your laser trainer leaves bullet holes where you hit.
readme_summary: ScreenPlink is a Python-based laser dry-fire shooting game where a webcam tracks laser impacts on a monitor, simulating shooting drills and games. It offers various drills, scoring, and multi-player support, designed for training, entertainment, and commercial use.
key_features: Laser dry-fire shooting game using a monitor as the target
Webcam-based hit detection and visual feedback (bullet holes)
Multiple drills and targets with scoring
Magazine simulation and empty-fire clicks
Two-player support with separate scoring and magazines
Automatic screen calibration
Free, offline, no ads, Apache-2.0 license for commercial use
Windows-only build (v1.0), no Python dependency for users
primary_use_case: A realistic and engaging dry-fire training and gaming system that uses a standard monitor as the target, allowing users to practice shooting skills in a safe and accessible way.
cover_image_prompt: A 3D isometric illustration of a dimly lit, modern man cave. In the center, a matte computer monitor displays a dynamic shooting range scene with targets. A sleek laser training pistol is aimed at the monitor, with a faint red laser beam connecting the pistol to a glowing 'impact point' on the screen. A small, unobtrusive webcam is positioned to the side, capturing the monitor's surface. Subtle digital particles emanate from the impact point, and the repository name 'ScreenPlink' is subtly integrated into a small UI element on the monitor's bezel. The overall mood is focused and engaging, with a cool color palette emphasizing the digital nature of the game.

name: Scrapling
description: 🕷️ The BEST Web Scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl! Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/EMgGbDceNQ and follow here for daily tips and tricks: https://x.com/Scrapling_dev
readme_summary: Scrapling is a Python web scraping framework designed for efficient data extraction from single requests to large-scale crawls. It leverages modern web technologies and offers robust features for handling complex scraping tasks.
key_features: Handles single requests to full-scale crawls
Modern web scraping framework
Supports Playwright
AI-powered scraping capabilities
Data extraction
primary_use_case: Automated web scraping and data extraction from websites.
cover_image_prompt: A diligent digital librarian meticulously organizing vast, flowing rivers of data (representing web content) into a structured, glowing library. The librarian uses a magnifying glass that highlights specific data points, and small, ethereal code snippets float around them. In the background, a subtle, futuristic interface displays crawling progress. The overall mood is one of organized efficiency and intelligent data retrieval, with a clean, modern aesthetic. The style should be a 3D isometric illustration with soft, glowing lighting and a color palette of blues, purples, and gold.

name: two_claps_open
description: Open Chrome (or any file/app) by just clapping twice
readme_summary: This Python repository allows users to trigger actions, such as opening applications or activating voice assistants, by detecting a sequence of two claps. It processes audio input to identify clap patterns and execute predefined commands.
key_features: Clap detection using audio signal processing (bandpass filtering and peak detection)
Ability to open applications (e.g., Chrome) or execute custom commands upon detecting two claps
Option to activate a voice assistant agent with a double clap
Cross-platform compatibility (with specific setup for Windows)
Includes Python scripts for different functionalities (`two_claps_open.py`, `agent_on_clap.py`)
primary_use_case: Hands-free control of computer actions and applications through simple clap gestures.
cover_image_prompt: A stylized, friendly robot hand is captured mid-clap, emitting two distinct sound waves. These sound waves are visually represented as glowing, concentric rings of energy. One set of rings is shown directly opening a digital portal that reveals a vibrant, open browser window (like Chrome). Another set of rings is shown activating a floating, ethereal orb that glows with intelligence, symbolizing a voice assistant. The background is a clean, modern workspace with subtle digital circuit patterns. The overall mood is magical and intuitive, emphasizing effortless control. The art style should be a 3D isometric illustration with soft, glowing highlights and a clean, uncluttered composition.

name: voicebox
description: The open-source AI voice studio. Clone, dictate, create.
readme_summary: Voicebox is an open-source, local-first AI voice studio that allows users to clone voices, generate speech in multiple languages and TTS engines, and use voice input for AI agents. It offers a comprehensive voice input/output solution that runs entirely on the user's machine, serving as a free alternative to cloud-based services like ElevenLabs.
key_features: Voice cloning from short audio samples
Speech generation with 23 languages and 8 TTS engines
Global hotkey for dictation into any text field
Voice output for AI agents
Local-first operation, running entirely on the user's machine
Free and open-source
primary_use_case: To provide users with a powerful, local, and free AI voice studio for cloning, generating, and utilizing voices across various applications and AI agents.
cover_image_prompt: A skilled artisan in a cozy, modern workshop, meticulously sculpting a human-like voice from raw audio waves. The artisan holds a microphone (input) in one hand and a small, glowing speaker emitting a clear, distinct voice (output) in the other. Surrounding the artisan are shelves filled with diverse audio 'ingredients' representing different languages and TTS engines. Subtle UI elements displaying voice waveforms and language options are visible on a nearby workbench. The repository name 'Voicebox' is subtly etched into a wooden beam overhead. The scene is bathed in warm, inviting light, rendered in a 3D isometric illustration style with clean lines and a focus on the creative process.
